# The front door's integrity fingerprint is wrong again: its guard has had no caller since the Brain split

## Context

`learn/benefits/Introduction.md` declares its own size, so a reader holding a truncated copy can tell that it is truncated. `check-front-door-fingerprint.mjs` kept that declaration true by construction, and a path-filtered workflow ran it. The cut manifest dispositioned that workflow `pin-fetch`: it was to stay in the Engine. #17806 deleted it instead. The script now lives only in the Brain, where nothing runs it against this file.

## The Problem

The declaration has been wrong after five of the six edits since the split. Measured with the guard's own `parseFingerprint` and `computeActual`:

| commit | declared bytes | actual bytes |
|---|---:|---:|
| `c623b2f63c` (08-27, the split) | 50,700 | 51,359 |
| `147b2a94e0` (08-30) | 50,700 | 51,425 |
| `bc0cbd2093` (09-05) | 55,414 | 55,414 (fixed by hand) |
| `237564317e` (10-01) | 55,414 | 55,397 |
| `b4f84d31c4` (10-11) | 55,414 | 56,597 |
| `8c071e0934` (10-16, `dev` today) | 55,414 | 56,728 |

Lines (337) and sections (12) hold on `dev`. A reader holding exactly the declared 55,414 bytes is missing 1,314 bytes, and the declaration tells them the copy is complete.

## The Architectural Reality

- ADR 0040 §2.7: "Engine-only contributor guards with no Brain dependency stay Engine-owned." The script imports only `fs`, `path` and `url`.
- #17783's R3 set the precedent: `check-guard-ci-parity` moved from the Brain to `buildScripts/util/` and gained a neo caller.
- neo's lints are `buildScripts/util/check-*.mjs`, with a spec under `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/` and their own workflow. `test.yml` selects tiers by changed files, so a docs-only edit to the front door needs the path-filtered workflow.

## The Fix

1. Relocate the guard to `buildScripts/util/check-front-door-fingerprint.mjs`, with its root two levels up and a `--fix` hint naming the new path. Its spec goes to `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/checkFrontDoorFingerprint.spec.mjs`.
2. Restore `.github/workflows/front-door-fingerprint.yml`, path-filtered to the front door, the guard and the workflow itself, at current action versions.
3. Run the guard's `--fix` on the front door.
4. A paired Brain ticket retires the Brain's copy, so the guard exists once.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] **AC-1:** the guard passes on the front door at head. On `dev` it fails, naming 55,414 against 56,728 bytes.
- [x] **AC-2:** the restored workflow runs the guard on a PR that touches the front door. The spec's mismatch arm is its seeded-drift control.
- [ ] **AC-3:** the Brain no longer carries the guard (the paired Brain PR).

## Out of Scope: The Rest of the Class

Nine of the thirteen `pin-fetch` gates in Grace's census on #17783 still have no CI caller in neo, the Brain or Skills, by file name or npm alias (measured 2026-10-18):
- `adr-seam-table`
- `adr-status`
- `discussion-lifecycle-audit`
- `identity-engine-coherence`
- `npm-script-entrypoints`
- `retry-bounds` (its alias `ai:lint-retry-bounds` has no caller)
- the two whose implementations are gone: `skill-manifest` and `tree-json`
- this one

Each needs its own disposition. This ticket takes the only one with a measured cost.
